name: Tekton Summary
description: The analysis summary as a readable report: maximum and mean displacement with the node they sit on, support reactions with an equilibrium check against the applied loads, extreme section forces with their location, and utilisation per EC5 computed here in the neutral layer - so it also works with the OpenSees backend, offline, without a licence or a design add-on. Every design number names the k_mod, gamma_M and service class it used. Buckling and lateral-torsional buckling are NOT verified: the neutral model carries no buckling length, and the report says so - a member that passes here may still fail on stability. Outputs the text, a CSV with one row per member, and the headline numbers separately; give 'path' a file name to write both to disk.

inputParameters.name: service_class
inputParameters.description: EC5 service class 1, 2 or 3. 1 = heated interior, 2 = covered outdoors, 3 = fully exposed. Default 1. An assumption, not a result - it is printed in the report.

inputParameters.name: duration
inputParameters.description: Load-duration class for k_mod: permanent | long-term | medium-term | short-term | instantaneous. Empty = inferred per load case from its action category, and the report says which.

inputParameters.name: gamma_M
inputParameters.description: Partial factor for the material. Empty = per material (1.3 solid timber, 1.25 glulam).

inputParameters.name: path
inputParameters.description: Optional file path. Writes the report there and the CSV next to it with a .csv suffix.

outputParameters.name: report
outputParameters.description: The summary as text, ready for a panel

outputParameters.name: csv
outputParameters.description: One row per member sample, worst first

outputParameters.name: max_utilization
outputParameters.description: Largest utilisation ratio; None when no check could run

outputParameters.name: backend_utilization
outputParameters.description: Largest utilisation the backend's own design add-on reported (RFEM, 'design' on Tekton Backend); None otherwise

outputParameters.name: ok
outputParameters.description: True when a report was produced
